title: Two kinds of feather
hook: Two feathers can do different jobs.

knows: Animals have structures and activities that can be studied.
doesNotKnow: In the drawing, the contour feather has a more coherent vane while the down feather has loose branches. Contour feathers help shape the outer plumage; the fluffy down layer helps trap insulating air. Real feathers vary.

misconception: The features shown in this question have only one possible interpretation.
objective: A bird has contour feathers on its body and soft down beneath them. Which typically has a more coherent, flattened vane?

claims.text: Two feathers can do different jobs. A bird has contour feathers on its body and soft down beneath them. Which typically has a more coherent, flattened vane?
